    fields = []
    current = []

        if ch == '"':

        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))

    def test_single_capacity_bucket(self):

        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))

        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))
        # 1 second elapsed -> 1 token refilled
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(1))

    def test_refill_capped_at_capacity(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=2, refill_rate=1)
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))
        # Huge elapsed time -> refill capped at capacity, not unlimited
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1000))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1000))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(1000))

    def test_no_refill_when_timestamp_unchanged(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=2, refill_rate=5)
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(10))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(10))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(10))

    def test_fractional_refill_not_enough_for_token(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=1, refill_rate=1)
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))
        # 0.5 sec elapsed with refill_rate=1 -> only 0.5 tokens, not enough
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0.5))
        # additional 0.5 sec -> total 1.0 tokens accumulated -> now allowed
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1.0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(1.0))

        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(2))

        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=1, refill_rate=1)
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))

    def test_refill_after_elapsed_time(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=2, refill_rate=1)
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))
        # 1 second elapsed -> 1 token refilled
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(1))

    def test_refill_capped_at_capacity(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=2, refill_rate=1)
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))
        # Huge elapsed time -> refill capped at capacity, not unlimited
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1000))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1000))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(1000))

    def test_no_refill_when_timestamp_unchanged(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=2, refill_rate=5)
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(10))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(10))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(10))

    def test_fractional_refill_not_enough_for_token(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=1, refill_rate=1)
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))
        # 0.5 sec elapsed with refill_rate=1 -> only 0.5 tokens, not enough
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0.5))
        # additional 0.5 sec -> total 1.0 tokens accumulated -> now allowed
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1.0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(1.0))

    def test_failed_allow_does_not_consume_token(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=1, refill_rate=0)
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        # refill_rate 0, no more tokens ever
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(1))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(2))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(100))

    def test_slow_refill_rate_multiple_steps(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=5, refill_rate=0.5)
        # Drain the bucket
        for _ in range(5):
            self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))
        # After 2 seconds, 1 token should have refilled
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(2))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(2))
        # After another 4 seconds (total elapsed 4s from last request at t=2),
        # 2 more tokens refill
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(6))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(6))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(6))

    def test_sequence_of_timestamps_realistic(self):
        rl = RateLimiter(capacity=10, refill_rate=2)
        # Bucket starts full at 10 tokens
        for _ in range(10):
            self.assertTrue(rl.allow(0))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(0))
        # After 1 second, 2 tokens refill
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(1))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow(1))
        # After 5 more seconds -> 10 tokens refill but capped at capacity 10
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow(6))
